question: Let $C$ be a circle and $L$ a line on the same plane such that $C$ and $L$ do not intersect. Let $P$ be a moving point such that the circle drawn with centre at $P$ to touch $L$ also touches $C$. Then the locus of $P$ is

options.A: a straight line parallel to $L$ not intersecting $C$
options.C: a parabola whose focus is centre of $C$ and whose directrix is $L$
options.D: a parabola whose focus is the centre of $C$ and whose directrix is a straight line parallel to $L$

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
